usedFor: Sulekha captures local service leads and Graphy holds learners, so “New Leads” can run “Create a Learner”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Leads” in Sulekha, then “Create a Learner” in Graphy
bestTemplate.why: A new lead becomes a learner record, ready to be enrolled in a course.

watchOut: “Create a Learner” needs an email and a name, so each Sulekha lead must carry both.
